tasks.title: Verify repository, branches, existing assets and available tools
tasks.acceptance: Identify exact file/commit provenance and missing assets. Preserve current work; report actual tools and account visibility, not guessed access.

tasks.title: Consolidate decisions, human blockers and real cost assumptions
tasks.acceptance: Use final 15-minute/30-minute offers. Batch unresolved non-secret inputs once; no purchases or stack drift.

tasks.title: Freeze interfaces, privacy boundary, math units and offer matrix
tasks.acceptance: Publish versioned input/event/offer contracts before parallel build. Document approval scopes and no-financial-data marketing boundary. Provide schema examples/negative examples and independent design review; runtime checks are owned by downstream tasks.

tasks.title: Establish integration baseline and reproducible check suite
tasks.acceptance: Select baseline by explicit branch reconciliation. Run existing checks; report pre-existing failures without weakening release guards.

tasks.title: Create and verify one branded workshop design slice
tasks.acceptance: Real desktop/mobile render using approved palette and one custom illustration. Bill-left/tool-right desktop becomes a readable mobile stack.

tasks.title: Create eight professional ink assets and manifests
tasks.acceptance: Eight actual sources and contextual renders, not only generation prompts. Rights, alt text, crops, checksums and no misleading artist attribution.

tasks.title: Apply reusable visual and accessibility rules to landing/deck assets
tasks.acceptance: No forked brand or duplicate design system. Forms, states, reduced motion and readable chart labels match the site.

tasks.title: Prepare selected deployment profile and environment boundaries
tasks.acceptance: One selected production hosting target; safe previews. No DNS/MX/firewall mutation without authorization.

tasks.title: Implement minimal Supabase schema, grants and RLS
tasks.acceptance: No financial-profile tables or anonymous access to operating records. Consent/events/jobs/orders support unique keys and scoped server operations.

tasks.title: Build validated server ingress and durable jobs/outbox
tasks.acceptance: Atomic accepted record plus job; truthful success/failure. Stable IDs, leases, retry/expiry and uncertain-outcome reconciliation.

tasks.title: Prepare self-hosted pinned n8n/SQLite Docker stack
tasks.acceptance: Official verified image, SQLite volume, loopback, owner bootstrap and explicit key. No latest tag, broad editor access or extra database for n8n.

tasks.title: Implement and prove backup/update/isolated restore routines
tasks.acceptance: Fourteen successful daily snapshots, key separately and encrypted off-host copy. Restore/update drill cannot send real messages or overwrite production silently.

tasks.title: Connect approved provider credentials and verify actual features
tasks.acceptance: Confirm Bill tenant/calendar, sender, payment mode and permission scopes. Do not promise unavailable attendance/booking/LinkedIn features.

tasks.title: Implement independently tested educational calculation core
tasks.acceptance: Explicit timing/tax/price basis; missing values not zero. Capital illustration disabled unless its limitations and validation meet contract.

tasks.title: Build four-chapter custom workshop state and forms
tasks.acceptance: Back/edit/skip/reset work with usable mobile layout. No LMS service, document uploads or mandatory financial disclosure.

tasks.title: Build accessible live charts and local milestone export
tasks.acceptance: Useful summary available without email/booking. Local export includes assumptions/incompleteness and accessible values.

tasks.title: Implement prerecorded clip rules and honest media states
tasks.acceptance: All branch combinations and fallback tested. Automated selection disclosed; no fake recording/personal-review claim. Local rule tests may use labelled test media. Real recordings and final media acceptance occur at C10/L02; no public placeholder release.

tasks.title: Verify full workshop privacy and interaction boundary
tasks.acceptance: Synthetic distinctive financial inputs appear in no outbound payload. No nonessential tracking leaks from the calculator routes.

tasks.title: Obtain authentic Bill voice reference and factual claim ledger
tasks.acceptance: Actual approved source/voice material, no invented autobiography or clients. Unknown credentials/claims remain pending rather than becoming copy facts.

tasks.title: Write 18 main capsules and 18 companion briefs in FR/EN
tasks.acceptance: Recordable scripts, visual cues, CTA, duration estimate and source/review fields. Different useful angles; no repetitive artificial cliffhangers.

tasks.title: Write all 12 workshop clips and exact interface copy
tasks.acceptance: Scripts match final units/inputs/privacy and branch meanings. Approved statement of 15-minute next step and no individualized review fiction.

tasks.title: Produce 10 fictional Crossroads cases and complete host/deck kit
tasks.acceptance: Case facts/options/answers/explanations are complete and fair. Host, moderator, scorecard, Q&A and outage/recording notices included.

tasks.title: Write first two complete article/LinkedIn packages
tasks.acceptance: Useful sourced articles with real attribution and metadata. No automatic publication or fabricated approval.

tasks.title: Finish remaining eleven article packages and freshness queue
tasks.acceptance: Thirteen total core packages with review-due dates and separate locales. Recheck date-sensitive facts before actual publication.

tasks.title: Write 16 email templates and all offer/error/confirmation copy
tasks.acceptance: Purpose/consent/timing/suppression fields and FR/EN versions. No one-hour book promise or unapproved advice guarantee.

tasks.title: Create six static ad concepts and three retargeting edit plans
tasks.acceptance: Two copy variants per concept, route/CTA mapping and live/prelaunch distinction. No fabricated performance or personal-attribute assertion.

tasks.title: Build exact 90-day calendar and asset-status manifest
tasks.acceptance: 26 posts, 13 article packages, ten reserve companions. Actual event dates/language and hashes govern publication.

tasks.title: Revise book offer/QR/print and fulfilment copy for 30-minute benefit
tasks.acceptance: Preserve real book, change only approved necessary material. Review markers removed only after real approval; actual print proof/terms required.

tasks.title: Record/edit approved workshop clips and first six social capsules
tasks.acceptance: Actual Bill files with rights, transcripts/captions and approved versions. Missing recordings remain blocked, not synthetic substitutes.

tasks.title: Finish remaining capsule recordings/edits and reserve cuts
tasks.acceptance: Complete 18 original recordings/edits and companion deliverable bank in approved available languages. No unrecorded language labelled as complete.

tasks.title: Build guide access/optional fulfilment path
tasks.acceptance: Approved PDF accessible without compulsory nurture opt-in. Download fallback works when email is delayed.

tasks.title: Build Crossroads registration/join/replay surfaces
tasks.acceptance: Actual date/cap/timezone/individual link behavior and explicit unavailable replay states. No assumed Google Meet iframe or exposed guest email list.

tasks.title: Implement exact meeting offer and proven scheduler handoff
tasks.acceptance: 15-minute intro and 30-minute book entitlement are distinct. Keep existing scheduler until chosen replacement proves conflicts/cancellation behavior.

tasks.title: Build book hosted-checkout, order and entitlement endpoints
tasks.acceptance: Only verified paid state issues one right; signed webhook and caps. Human-approved shipping/refund/consultation terms before live sales.

tasks.title: Build preferences, consent and unsubscribe surfaces
tasks.acceptance: Unsubscribe immediate in application; no automatic unblocking by upsert. Separate requested service and optional nurture purposes.

tasks.title: Build minimal authenticated operations view
tasks.acceptance: Visible failed jobs, book rights/fulfilment and confirmed meeting state. No CRM rebuild or workshop financial details.

tasks.title: Implement authenticated n8n/application job adapter
tasks.acceptance: Jobs claimed atomically with lease and identity; no arbitrary URLs/commands. n8n is not the authoritative consent/payment database.

tasks.title: Implement contact/consent sync workflow
tasks.acceptance: Idempotent upsert preserves provider suppressions. Language and consent provenance synchronized minimally.

tasks.title: Implement shared due-message dispatcher and daily send budget
tasks.acceptance: Operational priority, cap reservation, expiry, reconciliation and retry limits. Before-send eligibility is checked after lease, not only when queued.

tasks.title: Implement guide and workshop-access/follow-up workflows
tasks.acceptance: Deliver requested links without financial summaries. Nurture only for eligible consented contacts; no fake completion attribution.

tasks.title: Implement event lifecycle/reminder/replay workflows
tasks.acceptance: Correct actual times, cancellation and expiry handling. Attendance unknown has truthful neutral follow-up.

tasks.title: Implement verified purchase/rights/fulfilment workflows
tasks.acceptance: Duplicate payment events never issue duplicate entitlement/fulfilment. Shipping and 30-minute redemption messages reflect actual state.

tasks.title: Implement meeting reconciliation and acquisition suppression
tasks.acceptance: Actual provider/operator record triggers booked state. Documented daily manual fallback if callbacks/access unavailable.

tasks.title: Implement unsubscribes, replies and global suppression routine
tasks.acceptance: Queued marketing stops on withdrawal; meaningful reply triggers human follow-up. Cancellation/no-show does not automatically restart aggressive nurture.

tasks.title: Implement weekly article draft/review/publish handoff
tasks.acceptance: One idempotent weekly draft/package; human-gated publication. Authorized LinkedIn posting or explicit manual package, never scraping.

tasks.title: Implement health, quota, backup and dead-letter monitoring
tasks.acceptance: Independent backup-age/health monitoring and actionable deduplicated alerts. No financial/credential payload in alert channels.

tasks.title: Import/test RSS-email and webhook-Telegram smoke workflows
tasks.acceptance: Disabled importable JSON plus actual import/delivery to allowlisted targets. Authenticated webhook, bounded message and RSS/SMTP failure tests.

tasks.title: Implement technical SEO/GEO publication hygiene
tasks.acceptance: Public reviewed pages crawlable; protected drafts stay private. Truthful structured data; no promised AI ranking/citation mechanism.

tasks.title: Prepare local profile/review/partner distribution kit
tasks.acceptance: Owner-approved factual profile fields, genuine review request and partner invitation. No fabricated reviews or harvested outreach lists.

tasks.title: Assemble human-readable approval packets bound to versions
tasks.acceptance: Record actual reviewer decisions separately from agent checks. Permit recording/publication only for approved asset scope.

tasks.title: Run independent complete local regression/security/contract review
tasks.acceptance: Reproduce behavior in fresh context; no self-report acceptance. Return specific P0/P1 defects to owners with bounded repair.

tasks.title: Run authorized staging provider and recovery tests
tasks.acceptance: Real allowlisted receipt, test payments and calendar events observed. Mock versus provider versus production evidence explicitly separated.

tasks.title: Run external phone/desktop usability walkthrough with real media
tasks.acceptance: Actual device checks; unavailable physical Safari test is blocked/not run. Tester can complete exercise and find next step without financial disclosure.

tasks.title: Rehearse complete Crossroads event with moderator
tasks.acceptance: Timed ten-case/Q&A show works for external guest. Recording/privacy/outage procedure and native-feature fallback rehearsed.

tasks.title: Compile tested release manifest and unresolved gate report
tasks.acceptance: Exact source/media/workflow/migration versions and safe rollback. Missing human approvals remain blockers, not toggled booleans.

tasks.title: Conduct controlled invited pilot after scoped authorization
tasks.acceptance: Invited people actually complete agreed journeys; reconcile outcomes. P0/P1 fixed before public activation; failures are recorded truthfully.

tasks.title: Activate approved public customer paths gradually
tasks.acceptance: Only approved feature flags and artifact set go live. Live smoke proof, fallback and rollback/reconciliation owner present.

tasks.title: Launch only the approved capped advertising experiment
tasks.acceptance: Account/category/targeting verified and destination working. Approved cap and actual campaign IDs; no automatic increase. If paid ads are not authorized, remain blocked_human; do not prevent organically acquired cohorts from weekly reporting.

tasks.title: Operate weekly delivery/content/metrics loop
tasks.acceptance: Actual booked/held outcomes with unknowns preserved. One useful weekly content package and one bounded improvement proposal.

tasks.title: Review cohorts, economics and capacity at days 30/60/90
tasks.acceptance: Use actual software/ad/time/print costs and held-meeting cohorts. Keep/pause/adjust decisions approved, no invented forecasts. Include paid cohorts only if R02 ran; otherwise report organic cohorts and zero authorized ad spend.

tasks.title: Complete inventory and owner-operated handover
tasks.acceptance: All promised inventory substantive, rights/review states clear. Owner walkthrough, secret-location map, costs and recovery tested.

tasks.title: Close quarter and select next operating cycle
tasks.acceptance: Report real quarter outcomes, unresolved obligations and retained content bank. Renewal/scale decisions require explicit owner approval.
